privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Curio collects, why, and the choices you have. We keep it short and specific — we only collect what the service genuinely needs to deliver your daily digest.

sections.heading: What we collect
bullets: **Account details** — your email address, the name you give us, and either a password (stored only as a salted hash, never in plain text) or your Google account identifier if you sign in with Google.
**Your settings** — the AI-model topics you select, your edition (English or Korean), delivery hour and timezone.
**Quiz activity** — your answers and scores, so we can show your history and track retention.
**Email engagement** — whether a digest email was delivered, opened, or clicked, reported back to us by our email provider.
**Your own AI API key** (optional) — only if you add one in Settings. See "Your own API key" below.
**Technical data** — your IP address and browser details in short-lived server logs, used to keep the service secure and to rate-limit abuse.

sections.heading: How we use it
bullets: To generate and send your personalized news digest each morning at your chosen hour in your local timezone (we detect it from your device, or you can pin one in Settings).
To build the recall quiz attached to each digest and remember your results.
To operate your account, secure it, prevent abuse, and respond when you contact us.
We do not sell your data, use it for advertising, or share it with anyone for their own purposes.

sections.heading: Service providers & international transfers
paragraphs: We share the minimum necessary data with providers who process it on our behalf. Most are based outside Korea, so your data is transferred to them over encrypted connections (TLS) whenever you use Curio, and kept only as long as each needs it or until you delete your account:
bullets: **Amazon Web Services** (USA) — hosts our servers and database, which hold the account data above.
**Cloudflare** (USA, global network) — delivers the site over HTTPS and protects it from attacks; sees your IP address and requests.
**Anthropic (Claude)** (USA) — summarizes source articles into your digest and writes its quiz. We send article text, not your identity.
**Google** (USA) — Google sign-in, if you choose it (we receive your email, name and Google account identifier), and the web fonts the site loads, which exposes your IP address to Google.
**Resend** (USA) — delivers our emails (your email address and the digest content) and reports delivery, open, and click events.
**Sentry** (USA) — receives error reports when something breaks, with sign-in tokens and codes stripped out.
**News API** and public lab feeds — supply the source articles we summarize. No personal data is sent to them.

sections.heading: Your own API key
paragraphs: If you add your own AI provider key, we store it encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and use it only to generate your own digests and quizzes, sending it only to that provider. It is never shown back in full, never used for other readers, and you can delete it in Settings at any time.

sections.heading: Cookies & sessions
paragraphs: We use authentication tokens to keep you signed in — a short-lived access token (15 minutes) held only in memory, and a refresh token in an HTTP-only cookie that we store on our side only as a hash. The refresh token is a sliding session: it stays valid while you use Curio and expires after about 3 hours of inactivity. Your browser's local storage keeps small preferences such as theme and language. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Generated digests and quizzes are automatically deleted after **30 days** on a rolling basis. Server logs are kept only briefly. Your account information is retained until you delete your account; it is then permanently erased from our database without delay, except where a law requires us to keep something longer.

sections.heading: How we protect it
bullets: Encrypted connections (HTTPS) everywhere; passwords and every sign-in token or code stored only as one-way hashes; API keys encrypted at rest.
Access to the servers and database is limited to the operator, and sign-in attempts are rate-limited.

sections.heading: Your rights & choices
bullets: **See or correct your data** — most of it is in Settings; for a copy of everything we hold, email us.
**Unsubscribe anytime** — every email includes an unsubscribe link; you can also turn delivery off in Settings.
**Delete your account** — this removes your profile, preferences, API key and history.
**Ask us to stop processing** your data, or withdraw your consent, by emailing [{email}](mailto:{email}). We reply within 10 days.
Curio is not intended for children under 14, and we don't knowingly collect their data.

sections.heading: Privacy officer
paragraphs: Curio's privacy officer is **Sangmyeong Lee** — email [{email}](mailto:{email}) for any privacy question or request.

If you are in Korea and a concern isn't resolved, you can also contact the Personal Information Infringement Report Center (privacy.kisa.or.kr, 118) or the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (kopico.go.kr, 1833-6972).

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If we update this policy, we'll revise the date above and, for material changes, notify you by email. Questions? [Contact us](/contact).

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Curio. By creating an account or reading a digest, you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: Curio is a daily email digest of AI-model news, tailored to topics you choose, with an optional recall quiz. Digests are delivered each morning at 06:00 in your local timezone (detected from your device, or pinned in Settings). We may add, change, or remove features as the product evolves.

sections.heading: Your account
bullets: Provide accurate information and keep your login credentials secure.
You're responsible for activity under your account.
You must be old enough to form a binding contract in your jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
bullets: Don't resell, scrape, or redistribute digest content at scale without permission.
Don't attempt to disrupt, reverse-engineer, or gain unauthorized access to the service.
Don't use Curio for anything unlawful.

sections.heading: AI-generated content
paragraphs: Digests and quizzes are produced with AI summarization of third-party sources. While we aim for accuracy, summaries **may contain errors or omissions** and are provided for general information only — not professional, financial, or legal advice. Always verify against the linked original sources before relying on anything.

sections.heading: Pricing
paragraphs: Curio is **free** — the full daily digest, complete archive, and all topics at no cost. If we ever introduce paid plans with additional features, we'll give **at least 30 days' notice** here and by email first, and you will never be charged unless you explicitly subscribe to one. The free daily digest isn't going away without notice.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The Curio name, design, and original editorial framing are ours. Source articles remain the property of their respective publishers; we link back to every original.

sections.heading: Termination
paragraphs: You may delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if these terms are violated or if required to protect the service or other users.

sections.heading: Disclaimer & liability
paragraphs: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, Curio is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

sections.heading: Changes & contact
paragraphs: We'll update the date above when these terms change. Questions about them? Email Sangmyeong Lee at [{email}](mailto:{email}) or visit our [contact page](/contact).

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.intro: Curio is run by **Sangmyeong Lee**. Email is the fastest way to reach me — I read every message and typically reply within two business days.

sections.heading: Email
bullets: **All enquiries** — general feedback, help & account issues, and privacy or data requests: [{email}](mailto:{email})

sections.heading: Pricing
paragraphs: Curio is **free** — every feature is open to everyone. If we ever add paid plans, we'll give notice first. See the [terms](/terms) for details.

sections.heading: Before you write
bullets: **Want to stop emails?** Use the unsubscribe link at the bottom of any digest, or turn delivery off in your settings — no need to email us.
**Found an error in a digest?** Tell us which issue and topic — it helps us improve the summaries.

sections.heading: New here?
paragraphs: Curio sends one tailored AI-model news digest every morning at 06:00 your local time, with a quick quiz to help it stick. [Subscribe free](/register) or [sign in](/login) to your account.
